name: Kenco MCS Perris I - Perris CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: The N and S truck courts are bounded by chain-link fencing (fence line visible in z20 satellite and 2018 Street View along the entrance driveway). Truck access is a single private driveway off Indian Avenue into the fenced court. No barrier-arm hardware could be positively resolved at the road in available imagery, but the fenced court with a single controlled driveway reads as a truck gate. Medium confidence on the exact gate hardware.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the driveway entrance or anywhere on the property in z20/z21 satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated/fenced truck court with no guard shack implies kiosk / app / remote check-in.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: dock banks on BOTH the N face and the S face — physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock banks on both long faces of a 579,708 SF DC; banded 50+. ~90 doors is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large striped trailer drop yards on the N side and the shared S yard, packed with trailers — well over 50 stalls.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck-court entrance with room to add an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck courts inside the fenced area before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Inland Empire logistics corridor in Perris, surrounded by warehouses and residential tracts; judged Urban.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~75 trailers counted across the N and S drop yards / dock aprons; approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~170 estimated from the striped N and S drop yards; low confidence.
